quotes.text: Went fishing with Capt. Manny with my husband and two boys. Picked Cheap Fishing because the price was very reasonable…we had a wonderful time catching a variety of fish and Captain Manny was so patient with us newbie fisherman. Nice guy with a great attitude, well-equipped boat, and the beautiful Florida Keys – Perfect day.

Thank you Capt. Manny for nothing short of a memorable experience! My Dad will be telling people about that nurse shark he reeled in for as long as he lives. And my girlfriend is already talking about going fishing again since she had so much fun on your boat. It was a really great time and we wish you all of the best.

My family really enjoyed our trip. As promised, we caught several fish including enough yellowtail snapper and porgy to feed the family. We were inexperienced at fishing and Manny was really great at showing us the ropes. He is a very friendly guy, and has a ton of experience and knowledge. Highly recommended!
Manny always keeps it fun and interesting. We caught big fish and a PILE of eaters !!! We’ll be back!
